name: EB Denim
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $260 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Jeans made in Los Angeles (about $275–$365) plus reworked vintage denim, jackets, knits and tees, sold through its La Brea store, website and department stores.

quote.q: I was scattering shorts across the locker room floor for $10 a pair.
